task: [Project: Nova/payment-svc] Set the downstream HTTP client timeout for payment-svc in Project Nova.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Nova] payment-svc downstream HTTP timeout is 8 s; this is set to accommodate the payment processor's P99 of 6 s plus 2 s buffer.
[Project: Nova] Timeout is configured via PAYMENT_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MS in payment-svc/config/production.yaml; default in code is 30 s and must be overridden.
[Project: Orion] All outbound HTTP timeouts in Orion are set to 3 s per the Orion latency SLA.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Orion; Orion has stricter latency requirements

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Legacy] payment-svc timeout was 30 s before the Legacy modernisation; the new value is 8 s in Nova.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: legacy value, current Nova value is 8 s in p1

candidate_memories.content: [General] HTTP client timeouts should always be set explicitly; relying on OS-level defaults causes unpredictable behaviour under load.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general principle, not Nova-specific value

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Nova] Payment processor SLA updated: P99 is now 6 s, down from 8 s; timeout buffer remains at 2 s.
